FINAL IVX AUTHENTICATION COMMAND CENTER
OWNER + ALL MEMBER ROLES — COMPLETE END TO END NOW

PRIORITY: P0 CRITICAL
EXECUTION MODE: FIX, DEPLOY, PHYSICAL TEST, VERIFY
SCOPE: EVERY AUTH API, ROUTE, PORT, DATABASE CONNECTION, ROLE, SESSION,
REGISTRATION FLOW, SIGN-IN FLOW, PASSWORD RECOVERY FLOW, AND CLIENT BUILD

Stop all non-authentication feature work until this certification is complete.

Do not return another audit-only report.
Use the existing forensic findings and immediately execute the repairs.

==================================================
0. REQUIRED FINAL RESULT
==================================================

The following users must work end to end:

1. OWNER
2. ADMIN
3. MEMBER
4. INVESTOR
5. BUYER
6. JV_PARTNER
7. TOKENIZED_INVESTOR / TOKENIZED_PROSPECT
8. BROKER
9. AGENT
10. LAND_OWNER

Required canonical flow:

REGISTRATION
→ INPUT VALIDATION
→ API REQUEST
→ SUPABASE AUTH USER
→ EMAIL/PHONE VERIFICATION
→ PROFILE
→ MEMBER
→ ROLE
→ ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
→ SESSION
→ AUTHORIZED DASHBOARD
→ SESSION REFRESH
→ LOGOUT
→ LOGIN AGAIN
→ APP RESTART
→ SESSION RESTORE
→ PASSWORD RECOVERY
→ AUDIT EVENT

No user type may use an unrelated or fake authentication system.

==================================================
1. IMMEDIATE OWNER ACCOUNT REPAIR
==================================================

The forensic report identified:

- Owner auth user exists.
- Correct production Supabase project is connected.
- Owner email is confirmed.
- Owner is not banned or deleted.
- Owner password was set programmatically.
- Owner does not know that password.
- Standard signInWithPassword returns invalid_credentials.
- A hidden passwordless owner backend exists.

Execute the correct repair now.

Do not create a new owner.
Do not delete the existing canonical owner.
Do not expose a permanent passwordless owner button.
Do not place service-role logic inside the client.

Required repair:

1. Preserve the existing owner auth user ID.
2. Preserve profiles, members, roles, messages, documents, and history.
3. Set a new owner-known password through a secure, owner-approved operation.
4. Revoke old sessions after the password change.
5. Verify the new password through normal Supabase signInWithPassword.
6. Verify the old password is rejected.
7. Verify the hidden passwordless endpoint is disabled, tightly restricted,
   or removed from the normal production authentication path.
8. Confirm owner role and permissions load after normal authentication.
9. Test logout, login again, and app restart.
10. Test Owner Dashboard, Admin Hub, Variables, Settings, and all owner routes.

Required owner status:

OWNER_STANDARD_PASSWORD_LOGIN: PASS
OWNER_PASSWORDLESS_DEPENDENCY: REMOVED / EMERGENCY_ONLY
OWNER_SESSION_PERSISTENCE: PASS
OWNER_ROLE_AUTHORIZATION: PASS

==================================================
2. COMPLETE AUTHENTICATION INVENTORY
==================================================

Find every authentication implementation in the repository.

Search for:

- signInWithPassword
- signUp
- verifyOtp
- resetPasswordForEmail
- updateUser
- setSession
- refreshSession
- getSession
- getUser
- signOut
- passwordless
- magic link
- OTP
- auth callback
- deep link
- owner login
- admin login
- member login
- investor login
- buyer login
- JV login
- tokenized login
- broker login
- agent login
- service-role auth
- hardcoded passwords
- development bypasses
- test users
- fallback sessions
- mocked identities

Return:

AUTH FILE:
FUNCTION:
ROUTE:
CLIENT:
USER TYPES:
PRODUCTION USED:
DUPLICATE:
DEPRECATED:
SECURITY RISK:
ACTION:

Delete or disable conflicting legacy flows only after proving the canonical
replacement works.

==================================================
3. API, ROUTE, PORT, AND CONNECTION MAP
==================================================

Build the complete authentication network map.

Inspect every relevant:

- public API route
- protected API route
- Supabase endpoint
- Render service route
- landing-page endpoint
- mobile API call
- web API call
- IVX IA Chat authentication call
- callback URL
- deep-link route
- redirect URL
- CORS origin
- reverse proxy rule
- DNS record
- port
- health route
- environment variable

Return one table:

SYSTEM:
DOMAIN:
PROTOCOL:
PORT:
BASE URL:
ROUTE:
HTTP METHOD:
AUTH REQUIRED:
TOKEN TYPE:
CLIENT:
BACKEND HANDLER:
DATABASE:
STATUS:
LIVE TEST:
TRACE ID:

Explicitly verify:

- `https://api.ivxholding.com`
- `https://ivxholding.com`
- `https://chat.ivxholding.com`
- Render internal service port
- Render external HTTPS routing
- Supabase URL
- Supabase Auth routes
- Android API base URL
- iOS API base URL
- web API base URL
- landing registration API
- password reset callback
- email verification callback
- Expo deep-link scheme
- Android app links
- iOS universal links

Do not invent ports.
Read the actual server configuration and Render runtime settings.

==================================================
4. REQUIRED AUTH API CONTRACTS
==================================================

Verify or implement canonical contracts for:

POST /api/ivx/auth/register
POST /api/ivx/auth/login
POST /api/ivx/auth/logout
POST /api/ivx/auth/refresh
GET  /api/ivx/auth/session
GET  /api/ivx/auth/me
POST /api/ivx/auth/verify-email
POST /api/ivx/auth/resend-verification
POST /api/ivx/auth/forgot-password
POST /api/ivx/auth/reset-password
POST /api/ivx/auth/verify-phone
POST /api/ivx/auth/resend-phone-code
GET  /api/ivx/auth/registration-health
GET  /api/ivx/auth/diagnostics
GET  /health

Use existing canonical routes when names differ.
Do not duplicate working endpoints merely to match these names.

For every endpoint test:

- correct request
- missing required field
- malformed JSON
- invalid email
- invalid password
- unauthorized request
- expired token
- malformed token
- wrong role
- database unavailable
- Supabase unavailable
- timeout
- duplicate submission
- rate limit
- CORS preflight
- HTTP status
- safe error body
- trace ID

==================================================
5. CANONICAL REGISTRATION TRANSACTION
==================================================

Every registration must execute as one controlled workflow:

1. Normalize email.
2. Normalize phone.
3. Validate required fields.
4. Validate role.
5. Check duplicate email.
6. Check duplicate phone.
7. Create Supabase auth user.
8. Create profile.
9. Create member.
10. Assign role.
11. Create role-specific record.
12. Create preferences.
13. Create notification settings.
14. Create audit event.
15. Send verification.
16. Return safe registration state.

Required roles and records:

MEMBER:
- auth.users
- profiles
- members
- role

INVESTOR:
- all MEMBER records
- investors

BUYER:
- all MEMBER records
- buyers

JV_PARTNER:
- all MEMBER records
- jv_partner profile/application record

TOKENIZED_INVESTOR:
- all MEMBER records
- tokenized profile/waitlist record

BROKER:
- all MEMBER records
- broker profile

AGENT:
- all MEMBER records
- agent profile

LAND_OWNER:
- all MEMBER records
- land-owner profile

OWNER/ADMIN:
Must not be publicly self-assigned.
Requires secure owner-controlled provisioning.

==================================================
6. REGISTRATION ATOMICITY AND ROLLBACK
==================================================

Prevent partial identities.

If any required step fails:

- do not leave an orphan auth user;
- do not leave a profile without a member;
- do not leave a member without a role;
- do not leave a role-specific record without its canonical identity.

Implement:

- database transaction where possible;
- compensating cleanup for external Supabase Auth creation;
- idempotency key;
- unique normalized email constraint;
- unique normalized phone constraint where business-approved;
- retry-safe registration;
- duplicate-request protection;
- exact failure stage;
- audit event;
- trace ID.

Required registration states:

STARTED
AUTH_CREATED
PROFILE_CREATED
MEMBER_CREATED
ROLE_ASSIGNED
ROLE_PROFILE_CREATED
VERIFICATION_PENDING
COMPLETED
FAILED
ROLLED_BACK

==================================================
7. DATABASE IDENTITY AUDIT AND REPAIR
==================================================

Audit production:

- auth users
- profiles
- members
- roles
- investors
- buyers
- JV records
- tokenized records
- brokers
- agents
- land owners

Return counts:

AUTH_USERS:
PROFILES:
MEMBERS:
VALID_LINKS:
UNLINKED_AUTH_USERS:
UNLINKED_PROFILES:
UNLINKED_MEMBERS:
NULL_AUTH_USER_ID:
DUPLICATE_EMAILS:
DUPLICATE_PHONES:
ORPHAN_ROLE_RECORDS:
MISSING_ROLE_RECORDS:
UNCONFIRMED_EMAILS:
BANNED_USERS:
DELETED_USERS:
INVALID_ROLE_VALUES:

Prepare and execute an owner-approved repair migration.

Rules:

- preserve valid identities;
- merge carefully;
- never delete automatically;
- preserve messages, documents, investments, offers, and audit history;
- create before/after counts;
- include rollback;
- record every repaired ID.

==================================================
8. ROLE AND AUTHORIZATION ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Authentication proves identity.
Server authorization determines access.

Required routing:

OWNER → Owner Dashboard
ADMIN → Admin Hub
MEMBER → Member Home
INVESTOR → Investor Dashboard
BUYER → Buyer Dashboard
JV_PARTNER → JV Dashboard
TOKENIZED_INVESTOR → Tokenized Dashboard/Onboarding
BROKER → Broker Dashboard
AGENT → Agent Dashboard
LAND_OWNER → Land/JV Dashboard

Verify server-side authorization for every protected endpoint.

Test:

- member attempts owner endpoint;
- investor attempts owner endpoint;
- buyer attempts investor-private endpoint;
- JV user attempts another user’s documents;
- altered client role;
- altered user ID;
- malformed JWT;
- expired JWT;
- revoked session;
- missing token;
- valid token with wrong role.

Expected:

401 for unauthenticated.
403 for authenticated but unauthorized.
Never return private content.

==================================================
9. LOGIN FLOW
==================================================

Canonical login:

EMAIL + PASSWORD
→ SUPABASE AUTH
→ SESSION
→ SERVER IDENTITY VERIFICATION
→ PROFILE
→ MEMBER
→ ROLES
→ ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
→ DASHBOARD

Test every stage independently.

Return:

LOGIN STAGE:
REQUEST:
RESULT:
LATENCY:
ERROR:
TRACE ID:

Do not display raw AuthApiError information to normal users.

User-facing invalid login:

“Email or password is incorrect.”

Owner diagnostics may show sanitized technical evidence with a trace ID.

==================================================
10. SESSION AND TOKEN LIFECYCLE
==================================================

Verify:

- access token creation;
- refresh token creation;
- secure local storage;
- token refresh;
- token expiration;
- revoked refresh token;
- logout;
- logout from all devices where supported;
- password change invalidation;
- app restart;
- Android process termination;
- backend restart;
- network loss;
- clock skew;
- multiple-device sessions.

Do not store tokens in plaintext logs.
Do not store service-role secrets in the app.

Required results:

SESSION_CREATE:
SESSION_PERSIST:
SESSION_REFRESH:
SESSION_REVOKE:
LOGOUT:
RESTART_RESTORE:
EXPIRED_TOKEN_RECOVERY:

==================================================
11. EMAIL VERIFICATION AND SMTP
==================================================

SMTP is currently reported as blocked.

Complete it now through the existing owner-controlled variables.

Before asking for credentials:

1. Check variable names.
2. Check Render binding.
3. Check Supabase SMTP configuration.
4. Run safe connectivity tests.
5. Return exact errors.

Only request owner action when configuration is missing, invalid, revoked,
or produces a verified connection/authentication error.

Required email tests:

- registration verification;
- resend verification;
- password reset;
- email change confirmation;
- delivery to real inbox;
- link expiration;
- link reuse rejection;
- correct redirect;
- mobile deep link;
- web redirect;
- spam-safe sender configuration.

Do not mark PASS from API acceptance alone.
Verify actual email delivery.

==================================================
12. PHONE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Where phone verification is required:

- send OTP;
- resend cooldown;
- invalid code;
- expired code;
- correct code;
- duplicate phone;
- country code formatting;
- rate limiting;
- provider failure;
- account linking;
- audit event.

Do not require phone verification for owner login unless explicitly enabled
by the owner’s security settings.

==================================================
13. PASSWORD RECOVERY
==================================================

Complete:

FORGOT PASSWORD
→ EMAIL DELIVERY
→ RESET LINK
→ APP/WEB CALLBACK
→ VALID RECOVERY SESSION
→ NEW PASSWORD
→ SESSION REVOCATION
→ LOGIN WITH NEW PASSWORD

Test:

- unknown email response does not reveal account existence;
- expired link;
- reused link;
- mismatched environment;
- Android deep link;
- iOS link;
- web callback;
- old password rejected;
- new password accepted;
- app restart persistence.

==================================================
14. OWNER SECURITY
==================================================

After normal owner password login works:

- optional MFA in Settings;
- session/device list;
- security-event history;
- password change;
- recovery methods;
- recent login activity;
- revoke device;
- audit owner actions.

Do not force MFA until the owner enables it.
Do not depend on a hidden passwordless endpoint for routine owner access.

==================================================
15. LANDING REGISTRATION
==================================================

Test registration from:

- Chrome Android;
- Samsung Internet;
- Instagram in-app browser;
- Facebook in-app browser;
- Safari iPhone;
- desktop Chrome;
- desktop Safari where available.

Required behavior:

1. Submit once.
2. Show immediate progress.
3. Prevent duplicate taps.
4. Create real auth identity.
5. Create profile/member/role.
6. Send verification.
7. Display clear next step.
8. Appear in Admin Members.
9. Preserve campaign/referral source.
10. Never remain indefinitely on “Submitting” or “Connecting.”

==================================================
16. MOBILE REGISTRATION AND LOGIN
==================================================

Audit every mobile screen:

- owner sign-in;
- member sign-in;
- registration;
- role selection;
- email verification;
- phone verification;
- forgot password;
- reset password;
- logout;
- session restore.

Verify:

- keyboard does not cover fields;
- password manager/autofill;
- show/hide password;
- capitalization disabled for email;
- correct content types;
- loading state;
- timeout;
- retry;
- offline message;
- accessibility;
- safe-area layout;
- no technical popup;
- no double navigation.

==================================================
17. CONNECTION AND FAILURE TESTING
==================================================

Test authentication under:

- Wi-Fi;
- cellular;
- slow connection;
- offline;
- network changes during request;
- DNS failure;
- TLS failure;
- Render cold start;
- API timeout;
- Supabase timeout;
- database timeout;
- HTTP 400;
- HTTP 401;
- HTTP 403;
- HTTP 404;
- HTTP 409;
- HTTP 422;
- HTTP 429;
- HTTP 500;
- HTTP 502;
- HTTP 503;
- malformed response.

Every failure must:

- stop loading;
- show a safe message;
- retain non-sensitive form data where appropriate;
- provide retry;
- store trace ID;
- avoid duplicate registration.

==================================================
18. CORS, REDIRECT, AND DEEP-LINK AUDIT
==================================================

Verify approved origins only:

- ivxholding.com
- www.ivxholding.com where used
- chat.ivxholding.com
- approved Expo/local origins only outside production
- production mobile scheme

Verify:

- OPTIONS requests;
- allowed methods;
- allowed headers;
- credentials policy;
- redirect allowlist;
- no wildcard with credentials;
- password-reset URL;
- verification URL;
- OAuth callback where used;
- Android app link;
- iOS universal link;
- custom Expo scheme.

Reject open redirects.

==================================================
19. RATE LIMITING AND BRUTE-FORCE PROTECTION
==================================================

Audit:

- login attempts;
- registration attempts;
- password reset;
- resend verification;
- phone OTP;
- API-level rate limits;
- Supabase rate limits;
- device cooldown.

Fix the current cooldown UX.

Requirements:

- count only real invalid credential responses;
- do not count network failures;
- do not count HTTP 5xx;
- show accurate remaining wait time;
- clear after successful login;
- avoid permanent lockout;
- owner recovery path remains secure;
- log abuse without exposing internals.

==================================================
20. OBSERVABILITY
==================================================

Every auth flow must have:

TRACE_ID
REQUEST_ID
USER_ID when known
EMAIL_HASH
ROLE
APP_VERSION
BUILD_NUMBER
GIT_SHA
PLATFORM
ROUTE
STAGE
LATENCY

SUPABASE_ERROR_CODE
FINAL_RESULT
TIMESTAMP

Do not log:

- passwords;
- access tokens;
- refresh tokens;
- OTP codes;
- secret keys;
- password hashes.

Create an owner-only Authentication Health Dashboard showing:

- registration success rate;
- login success rate;
- password reset delivery;
- verification completion;
- failures by stage;
- failures by platform;
- failures by app version;
- latency;
- active incidents;
- orphan identities;
- role-routing failures.

==================================================
21. AUTOMATED TEST SUITE
==================================================

Create unit and integration tests for:

- input normalization;
- registration state machine;
- idempotency;
- duplicate prevention;
- role assignment;
- role routing;
- authorization;
- token refresh;
- logout;
- password reset;
- verification;
- cooldown;
- error sanitization;
- CORS;
- redirects;
- deep links;
- rollback;
- database constraints.

Run:

- unit tests;
- integration tests;
- API contract tests;
- database tests;
- RLS tests;
- TypeScript;
- lint;
- dependency/security scan.

No skipped critical authentication tests.

==================================================

==================================================

Create fresh controlled production test identities using approved test
email addresses and phone numbers.

==================================================
23. PHYSICAL DEVICE CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Required environments:

- physical Android production APK;
- physical iPhone production/TestFlight build when available;
- production web;

==================================================
24. BUILD AND DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After repairs:

1. Commit all changes to the owner repository.
2. Return full GitHub SHA.
3. Run all automated tests.
4. Deploy backend.
5. Return Render deployment ID.
6. Verify `/health` HTTP 200.
7. Confirm runtime SHA equals GitHub SHA.
8. Deploy landing/web authentication changes.
9. Invalidate CloudFront if necessary.
10. Build a new Android production APK.
11. Return version, versionCode, build ID, SHA-256, and download artifact.
12. Install it on the physical Android device.
13. Build iOS when infrastructure is available.
14. Execute the complete real-account matrix.

Do not test the old APK after client changes.

==================================================
25. FREEZE AUTHENTICATION RELEASE
==================================================

After all critical tests pass:

- create an authentication release tag;
- record GitHub SHA;
- record Render deployment;
- record APK build;
- record database migration versions;
- record Supabase project reference;
- record test evidence;
- freeze canonical auth files;
- require regression tests for future auth changes.

==================================================
STRICT COMPLETION RULE
==================================================

Return VERIFIED only when:

- owner signs in using a known normal password;
- owner logout/login succeeds;
- owner session survives app restart;
- password reset email is delivered and completes;
- one fresh real member registers and signs in;
- one fresh investor registers and signs in;

exact dependency, endpoint, file, error, trace ID, and owner action.

Do not stop at audit.
